title: Mandate
description: Cryptographically signed spending mandate issued by a human principal.

mandate_id.description: Unique identifier for the mandate (e.g. mdt_001)

principal_id.description: Identity of the human authorizer (e.g. user_123)

agent_id.description: Authorized agent ID that can present this mandate

task.description: Human instructions specifying the approved scope of spending

max_total.description: Maximum cumulative amount the agent is allowed to spend

max_per_txn.description: Maximum amount allowed in any single transaction

step_up_over.description: Transactions over this amount require human step-up approval

allowed_merchants.description: List of approved merchant IDs or names

allowed_categories.description: List of approved purchase category codes

valid_from.description: RFC 3339 timestamp marking start of validity

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which payments are rejected

nonce.description: Unique random string preventing mandate replay

paypal_order_id.description: PayPal sandbox order ID holding authorization reserve

public_key.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key of the principal

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over canonical mandate fields
